import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        double length;
        Edge(int f, int t, double l) { from = f; to = t; length = l; }
    }

    static class Node {
        ArrayList<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    static class Graph {
        ArrayList<Node> nodes;
        ArrayList<Edge> edges;

        Graph(int nrNodes, int nrEdges) {
            nodes = new ArrayList<>(nrNodes);
            for (int i = 0; i < nrNodes; i++) nodes.add(new Node());
            edges = new ArrayList<>(nrEdges);
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, double length) {
            Edge e = new Edge(from, to, length);
            edges.add(e);
            nodes.get(from).out.add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        ArrayList<Integer> findAugmentingPath(int source, int sink, double[] flow, double[] pathCap) {
            // Priority queue with highest capacity first
            PriorityQueue<double[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Double.compare(b[0], a[0]));
            double[] capacity = new double[nodes.size()];
            int[] pred = new int[nodes.size()];
            Arrays.fill(pred, -1);
            capacity[source] = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
            pq.offer(new double[]{Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, source});

            while (!pq.isEmpty() && capacity[sink] == 0) {
                double[] top = pq.poll();
                double cap = top[0];
                int n = (int) top[1];
                if (cap < capacity[n]) continue; // lazy deletion

                for (int eIdx : nodes.get(n).out) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(eIdx);
                    double eCap = e.length - flow[eIdx];
                    if (eCap > 0) {
                        double newCap = Math.min(cap, eCap);
                        if (newCap > capacity[e.to]) {
                            capacity[e.to] = newCap;
                            pred[e.to] = eIdx;
                            pq.offer(new double[]{newCap, e.to});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            pathCap[0] = capacity[sink];
            ArrayList<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
            int eIdx = pred[sink];
            while (eIdx != -1) {
                path.add(eIdx);
                eIdx = pred[edges.get(eIdx).from];
            }
            return path;
        }

        double maxFlow(int source, int sink) {
            Graph residual = new Graph(nodes.size(), 2 * edges.size());
            for (Edge e : edges) {
                residual.addEdge(e.from, e.to, e.length);
                residual.addEdge(e.to, e.from, 0);
            }
            double[] flow = new double[residual.edges.size()];
            double[] pathCap = new double[1];
            ArrayList<Integer> path = residual.findAugmentingPath(source, sink, flow, pathCap);
            while (pathCap[0] > 0) {
                for (int eIdx : path) {
                    int revIdx = (eIdx % 2 == 1) ? eIdx - 1 : eIdx + 1;
                    flow[eIdx] += pathCap[0];
                    flow[revIdx] -= pathCap[0];
                }
                path = residual.findAugmentingPath(source, sink, flow, pathCap);
            }
            double maxFlow = 0;
            for (int eIdx : residual.nodes.get(source).out) {
                maxFlow += flow[eIdx];
            }
            return maxFlow;
        }
    }

    static class Room {
        int i, j;
        boolean[] infected = new boolean[61];
        boolean[] accessible = new boolean[61];
        int scientists, capsules;

        Room() {
            scientists = 0;
            capsules = 0;
            Arrays.fill(accessible, true);
        }

        int getNodeId(int timestamp) {
            return 2 + i + n * j + (n * n) * timestamp;
        }

        void setReactor() {
            Arrays.fill(accessible, false);
        }

        void setInfected(int timestamp) {
            if (timestamp < 61 && accessible[timestamp]) {
                accessible[timestamp] = false;
                infected[timestamp] = true;
            }
        }

        void spreadInfection(int timestamp) {
            if (timestamp < 60 && infected[timestamp]) {
                setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (i > 0) floorplan[i - 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (i < n - 1) floorplan[i + 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (j > 0) floorplan[i][j - 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (j < n - 1) floorplan[i][j + 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    static int n, t;
    static Room[][] floorplan = new Room[10][10];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        // Initialize floorplan
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                floorplan[i][j] = new Room();
                floorplan[i][j].i = i;
                floorplan[i][j].j = j;
            }
        }

        // Read scientist locations
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') floorplan[i][j].setReactor();
                else if (c == 'Z') floorplan[i][j].setInfected(0);
                else floorplan[i][j].scientists = c - '0';
            }
        }

        // Read capsule locations
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') floorplan[i][j].capsules = c - '0';
            }
        }

        // Spread infection over time
        for (int c = 0; c <= t; c++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (c < t) floorplan[i][j].spreadInfection(c);
                }
            }
        }

        // Build graph
        Graph g = new Graph(n * n * (t + 1) + 2, 100 * 4 * 60);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Room room = floorplan[i][j];
                if (room.scientists > 0) {
                    g.addEdge(0, room.getNodeId(0), room.scientists);
                }
                if (room.capsules > 0) {
                    g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(t), 1, room.capsules);
                }
                for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
                    if (room.capsules > 0) {
                        g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), room.getNodeId(t), 1000);
                    }
                    if (room.accessible[c]) {
                        if (i > 0) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i - 1][j];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        if (i < n - 1) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i + 1][j];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        if (j > 0) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i][j - 1];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        if (j < n - 1) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i][j + 1];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        double result = g.maxFlow(0, 1);
        System.out.println((int) result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
